# Rust Project Structure

## Files

### `.gitignore`

A top-level `.gitignore` file should be present, see file
[dot-gitignore](./dot-gitignore), which should ignore *at least*:

* `/target`; Generated by `cargo build`; will have compiled files, executables,
  documentation, etc.
* `Cargo.lock`; should be ignored for libraries, but included for executables.
* `/cobertura.xml`; Machine-readable coverage report created by 
  `cargo tarpaulin`.
* `/tarpaulin-report.html`; Human-readable coverage report created by 
  `cargo tarpaulin`.
* `**/*.rs.bk`; Backup files created by `rustfmt --backup`.
